title: Metekhi church
visualBrief: Specific standing Metekhi church: mapped stone body with intersecting gables, three projecting eastern apses and metal cap roofs, twelve-sided drum with narrow real window apertures/blind arched surrounds, grey conical standing-seam roof and metal cross. Projecting north porch has a gabled brick/stone front, real pointed side arches, two narrow front windows and a recessed timber church entrance. Shared ashlar/brick/metal textures, original simplified archivolts/lozenge relief and short local approaches. Natural cliff, terrace, river, monument and independent buildings remain host context. No full ritual interior or copied inscription/stone inventory.
